description: Declared execution order for the extracted baseline migrations (issue #787). The baseline is a frozen extraction of the production structure; its correct apply order was established empirically and is NOT derivable from a numeric sort, because every schema numbers its object-type folders starting at major 1. This file is the machine-readable form of the sequence that run_all_migrations.sh previously hardcoded as bash.
notes: A segment claims every major in (previous through_major for that schema, through_major].
Every non-timestamp V file under scripts/ must be claimed by exactly one segment; migration_plan.py fails hard otherwise.
grants=true segments are skipped when a runner is invoked with --no-grants.

oracle_user is the connection identity, which is NOT always the schema folder: DBA migrations connect as SYS with SYSDBA. Grants must run as the grantor, which is why CONSEP and THE each appear twice.

Baseline majors are all <= 16, so the whole baseline sorts before any timestamped migration (12+ digit major). Renumbering into globally unique ranges is deliberately NOT required - see docs/cross_schema_migration_plan.md.

segments.comment: SYS objects: users, roles, tablespaces, directories, profiles
THE grants, run as THE - deliberately after CONSEP grants
